authoritative_sources.content: orca-agent-status.ts の ctx.agentKind と parentSession による誤判定を修正してください。Orca管理ファイルなので生成元を直し、分岐したメインセッションでは状態通知が届き、子エージェントは親タブの状態を上書きしないことを検証して、インストールまで進めてください。

Local Orca generator fix and install. Source baseline: installed app commit73930bedee1b2492f8445d1867580924bf4db15e. Target commit1ec94bef2e45f9ce75ac98715f28aa098acd9578 in /Users/kazuma/orca/workspaces/orca/fix-omp-fork-status. Explicit runtime ctx.agent.kind main/sub determines OMP role; fork lineage must not silence a main. Subagent-first callbacks, normal tool/completion and model/session/shutdown callbacks must not claim or corrupt parent pane. Preserve conservative legacy context behavior and Pi behavior. Do not manually patch generated ~/.omp extension, no upstream writes, no existing agent restarts. Required verification: actual generated extension over isolated HTTP into actual Orca receiver mapping working/done; focused Pi regression tests. Native Node full src/main/pi suite passed466/466; Bun suite failed5 unrelated rpc-capture-replay tests because node:sqlite is unavailable, not concealed. Source formatting and lint checks passed. Installation is pending required build capacity clearance (27GiB observed vs50GiB required); do not approve release/install absent proof. Reviewer is read-only, runs no build/lint/tests/formatters and no external/network/live probes; parent owns final gate and installation. Return substantive correctness/safety/reuse review with product/process-only classification and explicit APPROVED or CHANGES_REQUESTED. Acceptance of source review does not mean installed.

--- a/docs/site/content/docs/notifications.mdx
+++ b/docs/site/content/docs/notifications.mdx
@@ -8,6 +8,8 @@ Orca runs agents, not just terminals, so it knows when an agent actually finishe
 
 When an agent transitions from working to idle, Orca fires a notification — system notification, sound, and a chip on the worktree.
 
+OMP identifies the main session separately from its subagents. A forked or resumed main session keeps reporting its activity and completion, even when its transcript records a parent session. Subagent events do not replace the parent pane's session, model, or status.
+
 ## Persistent bell
 
 The header bell shows unread notifications across all worktrees. Clicking a notification jumps to the matching worktree and pane.
